items.title: Critical NetScaler Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
items.description: Tracked as CVE-2026-19490, the authentication bypass flaw has been exploited in the wild since at least September 3. The post Critical NetScaler Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Widened Scan Turns Up Fourth Rogue Claude Cyber Incident
items.description: Anthropic is most concerned about Claude Mythos 5’s reckless behavior after recent incidents in which real systems were hacked. The post Widened Scan Turns Up Fourth Rogue Claude Cyber Incident appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: 4.1 Million Impacted by AdaptHealth Data Breach
items.description: In June 2026, hackers stole personal, health, and insurance information from AdaptHealth’s systems. The post 4.1 Million Impacted by AdaptHealth Data Breach appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Microsoft says September updates fix mouse settings reset issues

items.title: Organizations Warned of Cisco Secure FMC Exploitation
items.description: Cisco and CISA have flagged exploitation of CVE-2026-20079, a vulnerability disclosed in March 2026. The post Organizations Warned of Cisco Secure FMC Exploitation appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: CISA: WatchGuard RCE flaw now exploited in ransomware attacks
items.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has confirmed that ransomware gangs are also exploiting a critical WatchGuard Firebox firewall vulnerability, which it flagged as actively exploited in December. [...]

items.title: Microsoft fixes bug that wiped Windows desktop settings
items.description: Microsoft says the September 2026 Patch Tuesday updates fix a known issue causing desktop settings to be lost or reset on some Windows devices. [...]

items.description: The exploit provides full System privileges on Windows machines running the September 2026 patches. The post New ‘ShieldCrash’ Zero-Day Exploit Targets Microsoft Defender appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: EU Cyber Resilience Act to Enforce New Reporting Requirements
items.description: Starting Friday, businesses operating in the EU will have just 24 hours to notify the government any time they discover serious product security incidents.

items.title: Trezor warns users of email provider breach, phishing attacks
items.description: Trezor warned customers on Wednesday that threat actors who breached its third-party email provider are targeting them in phishing attacks. [...]

items.description: Cisco has confirmed that a maximum-severity authentication bypass vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-20079 in its Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) software is being actively exploited in attacks. [...]

items.title: Mythos Vulnerability Firehose Hits a Human Bottleneck
items.description: An analysis of Project Glasswing findings shows only a fraction have reached disclosure, and an even smaller number have been fixed.

items.title: US Government Accuses Chinese AI Firms of Distilling Frontier Models
items.description: US agencies claim Chinese companies covertly extracted billions of tokens from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and SpaceX's Grok to reduce development costs.

items.title: U.S. Disrupts Xinbi Guarantee Scam Marketplace, Freezes $52.8 Million in Crypto
items.description: The U.S. Department of Justice (DoJ) on Wednesday announced coordinated actions aimed at an illicit online marketplace called Xinbi Guarantee that offered scam services, including seizing Telegram channels used to run the service, confiscating two cryptocurrency wallets, and deploying the Scam Center Strike Force to Madagascar to help disrupt 13 scam compounds run by Chinese organized crime

items.title: Identity-Based AI Attack Threatens Security of Enterprise Data
items.description: "Workflow identity hijacking" can bypass standard security controls and hijack an organization's data by sending a basic request through an unauthenticated entry point.
